title: Ongoing hybrid program: semen extraction during abductions

tellings.quote: Whitley Strieber who talk about you know semen extraction taking place during alien abductions.

plain: The claim is that people taken by aliens have semen extracted from them, as part of an ongoing programme to breed human and alien hybrids. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove raises it, pointing to the writer Whitley Strieber as one of those who "talk about you know semen extraction taking place during alien abductions." If true, it would mean abductions serve a deliberate breeding effort.
